race.comment: EXPLOSIVE POWER (3) comes through stronger BM65 company at Gold Coast Poly and is better assessed on his previous fifth there, when interfered with late and beaten only 2.5L. The 1.5kg claim also helps. Goes on top. ARCHERS REIGN (8) was placed in that same BM65 last week and had an excuse when held up as favourite the run before, so he has a clear case if he brings that form back to turf. FAR CRY (9) lacks the same winning edge, but her Gatton second on soft ground two runs ago reads well enough, and Lerena going on keeps her firmly in calculations. HE IS THE KISS (6) backs up quickly and is knocking on the door. Likes this trip and is worth keeping onside.
